fact_check.claim: Intro and 'Colleges agree on the 57th-day idea': Cornell's drop deadline is the 57th day university-wide
fact_check.note: The 57-day rule is stated by A&S and Engineering. The Vet College add/drop policy PDF does not use it: it allows one week at the start of each distribution period, then dropping results in a W on the transcript plus a $100 fee. The article claims this PDF 'would not open as readable text', but it is readable (text extracts and renders), so the previous fix to add a Vet row was not applied and the 'colleges agree' framing is contradicted by an official page. The PDF is undated, so it may be out of date, which the article should say.

fact_check.claim: Hotel Administration, AAP, Dyson and CIS rules not checked / not in table
fact_check.note: Article discloses these as not confirmed. This is acceptable disclosure; not a factual claim.

beats_top.query: cornell add drop deadline W on transcript
beats_top.why: The #1 result covers Arts & Sciences only, with no 2026-27 dates in one place and no comparison of colleges, W costs or the pending senate change. Ours answers in the first paragraph with dates and gives a situation-specific read for early November.
changes: Add a Vet College row (one week to add/drop, then a W plus a $100 fee, source PDF undated) and stop saying the 57th-day rule applies across colleges.
Remove the claim that the Vet PDF would not open.
Say in the first paragraph that the 57th-day rule is A&S and Engineering wording and that other colleges differ.

fixes: Add a Vet College row to the College by college table: free drop 'First week of the distribution period', W window 'Dropping after the first week results in a W and a $100 fee (undated policy)', source https://www.vet.cornell.edu/sites/default/files/003-Add-DropPolicy.pdf
Delete 'its add/drop policy PDF would not open as readable text for us' and remove the Vet College from the not-checked sentence
Change 'Colleges agree on the 57th-day idea but word the W rules differently' to say Arts & Sciences and Engineering use the 57th day while the Vet College uses one week
In the first paragraph, qualify 'Cornell's drop deadline for a regular semester course is the 57th day' as the Registrar-calendar date for most undergraduate colleges, not the Vet College
